children: Fairlead Strategies founder Katie Stockton named three warning signs that could make her more bearish as the share of stocks above their 50-day average fell to 21%, matching the March low. She said support remains intact and last Friday may have marked a short-term low for chips, according to BeInCrypto. Her triggers are broad support breaks, wider credit spreads and a decisive VIX breakout; she views current credit stress as localized. The SOX fell 11.4% last week; BTIG said the decline could last into 2027. CoreWeave’s 2032 notes yielded about 14.8% after its shares fell roughly 16% on Oct. 14.

title: Katie Stockton Names 3 Warning Signs That Could Deepen the Stock Selloff
